baseline.description: Current proven baseline for ordinary game code. -fhex-asm only affects emitted assembly formatting.

prologue_fix.description: Try when a valid function differs specifically in leaf/non-leaf prologue or LR-save behavior. Not yet proven globally for Drill Dozer.

o3.description: Experimental O3 profile. Some already tested functions are identical at O2/O3, so use only when O2 misses.

sdk.description: Older SDK-style compiler profile for Nintendo runtime/audio candidates.

flash_o1.description: Candidate profile for prebuilt flash-library style code.
